name: Hyper Panda

note: Live Saudi perfume WooCommerce store (Arabic); the former Salla store now redirects to perfumekh.com as the active site, and Instagram @khperfumes_sa is active. Perfume is an approved repeat-purchase category (Gate 2); http_code=000 was a proxy/anti-bot artifact (Gate 4).

name: Petrogen بتروجين
note: Fuel/gas-station operator and franchise ('petroleum services... establishment and operation of gas stations'). Fuel stations are an explicit Gate 2 exclusion.

name: Paris United Group
note: The live site's own meta describes a 'Qatar-based diversified business group in retail, FMCG distribution, trading, real estate, construction and automotive.' Mixed conglomerate with hard-excluded divisions; parent excluded per Gate 6.

name: Primary Care Medical Co.
note: The ICP itself records this as a medical clinic misread as pharmacy retail (Gate 7). Healthcare/clinics are excluded under Gate 2 (retail pharmacy chains are the only exception, which this is not).

name: rihafbeauty

name: Nasser Bin Khaled and Sons Holdings
note: Automotive-led Qatari conglomerate (Mercedes-Benz distributor) spanning construction, real estate, industrial and healthcare. Mixed conglomerate parent excluded (Gate 6) / automotive (Gate 2).

name: sbie-arabia
note: Domain is hijacked/repurposed as an Indonesian online-gambling site ('Hokiemas... Slot Online' in the latest 2026 archived snapshot); no legitimate retail business findable. Matches Gate 4's hijacked-spam-domain fail pattern, with no country/retail identity on record (Gate 7 default OUT).

note: Real Qatari supermarket chain (6 Doha stores) run by Qatar-based licensee Al Wataniya International Holding, live at spar-qatar.com with QAR online grocery (also Snoonu/Talabat). Grocery approved, local operator HQ'd in-country (Gates 1/2/4); the record's sparqatar.shop is a dead/parked domain but the business is live.

name: Saudi Parts Center Company
note: Live site sells heavy-equipment/truck diesel-engine spare parts to B2B sectors (construction, oil & gas, military) via request-a-quote, no consumer cart. Automotive/heavy-equipment parts (Gate 2) plus no consumer storefront (Gate 4).

name: SmartLink BPO Solutions
note: Business-process-outsourcing / contact-center provider (name and known company). B2B services, an explicit Gate 2 exclusion; no consumer retail.

name: mo4cars
note: Live site is a car showroom/dealership (Mohammed Bin Thaar Al Ajmi car showroom; brands Changan/Ford/Hyundai/MG/Nissan). Automotive dealership, Gate 2 exclusion.

name: cool.sa
note: Live site (cool.sa) is an 'HVAC Supplier' selling chiller & AC spare parts and refrigerants across KSA. Construction/HVAC spare-parts supply, a narrow non-consumer line (Gate 2 construction/hardware; Gate 3 narrow), not qualifying consumer retail.

name: Steel Force
note: Live e-store sells '9000+ products in Steel and Building Materials' (mild/stainless/galvanized steel, roofing, cladding). Construction materials, an explicit Gate 2 exclusion.

name: Oncost Trading Company
note: Kuwait's leading FMCG wholesale-to-retail chain, 22 outlets, live at oncost.com with KWD online grocery. Its substantial dedicated retail arm passes on its own merits alongside the wholesale line (corrected Gate 2, like Union Trading); Kuwait-HQ'd (Gate 1). http_code=000 was a proxy artifact.

name: Mazaya Food
note: Live 'Mazaya Store' online retailer (SAR; general merchandise + grocery) plus a physical hypermarket, HQ Qatif KSA. Its own dedicated consumer retail arm qualifies despite a coexisting food-distribution line (corrected Gate 2); approved category, Saudi (Gates 1/2/4).

name: tas-helat
note: Tas'helat operates fuel service stations with attached Sahel Mart convenience stores and cafes; the site is informational with no cart. Fuel stations (Gate 2) plus no live transactional store (Gate 4).

name: The Blue Group - Qatar
note: Qatari group behind Blue Salon, Doha's luxury department store (500+ brands across fashion/beauty/fragrance/luggage/home, live QAR e-commerce at bluesalon.com). Department store is an approved category, Qatar-HQ'd (Gates 1/2/4); thebluegroup.qa is live behind Cloudflare, not dead.

name: Tawseel Media Group
note: Actually Kuwait's largest e-commerce retail group: flagship Taw9eel hyperstore ~80,000 items plus Sheeel, Thouqi (fashion), Tawarid, AlManzil, 1.6M+ orders in 2024, Kuwait HQ. Large-scale general-merchandise/grocery/fashion e-commerce (Gates 1/2/5); the 'construction' tag was a false keyword match (likely 'sanitary ware').

name: Cytotec pills in Saudi (spam listing)
note: Illegal abortion-pill (Cytotec) spam sold via Telegram, not a legitimate retailer, and the domain is dead. Fails Gate 2 (not a real approved-category retailer) and Gate 4.

name: United Yousef Naghi Co. Ltd.
note: Diversified Jeddah conglomerate (LG distribution + electronics/appliance showrooms + tires + hospitality + B2B ICT); the e-commerce domain does not resolve and no live consumer online store or 50k+ app was found. Mixed-conglomerate parent excluded (Gate 6) with no confirmed live digital channel (Gate 4); a dedicated retail sub-brand like EDDY would need its own row.

name: NBK - Qatar Automobiles Company
note: Qatar Automobiles Company is an automotive distributor/dealer (Gate 2 exclusion); the record's victorygroup24.ru is an unrelated hijacked domain. Correctly OUT.

name: Virgin Megastore Saudi Arabia
note: Substantial live entertainment/electronics/books retailer in an approved category with a Saudi operating entity HQ'd in Jeddah (201-500 staff, founded 2008), so the 'dead site' reason is wrong; but the master franchise is held by Megastores of Lebanon S.A.L., leaving Gate 1 (is the operating entity's true global HQ Saudi or Lebanese?) genuinely unresolved.
